svg.title: Every controlled GHK-Cu trial in people we could find
svg.desc: Venous leg ulcers, 1992 (university trial, ProCyte cream): n=86, No better than placebo; Diabetic foot ulcers, 1994 (ProCyte co-authors, gel): n=181, Ulcers closed more; best if started after debridement; Diabetic foot ulcers, Phase III, 1994 (ProCyte, 30 centers): n=511, No better than placebo. No journal paper found; Ulcerative colitis, 1996 (ProCyte, enema): size not disclosed, “Slight improvement.” Size not disclosed; Skin after laser resurfacing, 2006 (private practice, creams): n=13, No objective difference; patients rated it better; Injected GHK-Cu, anything (the way it’s used on X): n=0, No trial found

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
